<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def sq(f):
    o={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']>=10 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            bb=n['boundary']; o.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(p[0] for p in bb),max(p[0] for p in bb),min(p[1] for p in bb),max(p[1] for p in bb)))
    return o
print('start:', sq(current_frame))
# UP to align beam with R row (player 24-29 -> 18-23, beam rows ~20-21)
action(['UP'], intent='explore')
print('after UP:', sq(current_frame))
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
# find beam rows (rows with many w/g between col 16 and 45)
beamrows=[r for r in range(12,45) if sum(1 for c in range(17,40) if a[r][c] in 'wg')>10]
print('beam rows:', beamrows)
# extend past R then retract
action(['RIGHT','LEFT'], intent='explore')
print('after RIGHT,LEFT:', sq(current_frame))
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
beamrows=[r for r in range(12,45) if sum(1 for c in range(17,40) if a[r][c] in 'wg')>10]
tip=max((ci for ci in range(16,50) if a[beamrows[0]][ci] in 'wg'), default=None) if beamrows else None
print('beam rows now:', beamrows, 'tip:', tip)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
